dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: What changes have you noticed during the last few weeks?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: I have been extremely thirsty and drinking much more water than usual for around three weeks.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you also been urinating more frequently?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I wake up several times during the night to use the bathroom.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: He has also lost weight. We checked recently and he is about four kilograms lighter.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes, and I was not trying to lose weight.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Is there diabetes in your family?

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: Yes. His father and one of his grandparents both have type two diabetes.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you had blurred vision or unusual fatigue?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: I have been more tired than normal, but my vision seems fine.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: We should check your blood glucose today and arrange appropriate laboratory tests.
